heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P effortlessly handles Sunlu High Speed PLA straight out of the box using its stock stainless steel nozzle and open-frame design. Leveraging a max volumetric flow rate of 24 mm³/s, the printer reliably sustains high-throughput speeds up to 286 mm/s without requiring hardware upgrades.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (clean with Isopropyl Alcohol or warm soapy water, no adhesive required)
slicerTweaks: Set 'Max volumetric speed' under Filament Settings -> Basic Information to 24 mm³/s to prevent underextrusion at high speeds.
Adjust Nozzle Temperature to 223°C across all layers to ensure complete melting at high flow rates.
Calibrate Pressure Advance (PA / Flow Dynamics) in OrcaSlicer to approximately 0.022-0.028 for sharp corners at 286 mm/s.
Set Part Cooling Fan speed to 80% Min and 100% Max, with Aux Fan disabled or kept under 30% to prevent localized warping.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Matte finish and layer weakness during rapid print moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Extrusion temperature drops below the required melt rate when accelerating toward the 24 mm³/s limit.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Increase print temperature from 223°C to 230°C or drop the volumetric flow limit to 20 mm³/s in OrcaSlicer.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner bulging or blobbing on high-speed deceleration
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Uncompensated nozzle pressure due to high melt fluidity of HS-PLA.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Run OrcaSlicer's built-in Pressure Advance calibration and update the PA k-value (typically around 0.024 for direct drive).

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: First layer peeling or curling from the build plate
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Contaminated PEI surface or excessive cooling fan activation during the initial layers.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Scrub the Textured PEI plate with dish soap and warm water, keep bed at 60°C, and ensure fan is at 0% for the first 3 layers.

faq.question: Can I reach 286 mm/s on the Bambu Lab P1P with Sunlu HS-PLA using the stock 0.4mm nozzle?
faq.answer: Yes. With a volumetric flow limit of 24 mm³/s and a standard 0.2mm layer height with 0.42mm line width, 286 mm/s is fully achievable on the stock stainless steel nozzle.

faq.question: Does the P1P need an enclosure to print Sunlu High Speed PLA?
faq.answer: No. PLA prints best in open, well-ventilated conditions to avoid heat creep and ensure rapid layer solidification.

faq.question: Do I need a hardened steel nozzle upgrade for Sunlu HS-PLA?
faq.answer: No. Standard Sunlu High Speed PLA is non-abrasive, making the stock stainless steel nozzle completely suitable.

faq.question: Why is my Sunlu HS-PLA stringing on travel moves?
faq.answer: High-speed PLA has lower viscosity than standard PLA; ensure your direct drive retraction is set between 0.6mm-0.8mm at 35 mm/s and turn on wipe on retract.
